subject: general
question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7b34c4b090acadec5bdeb12700ee5ad88a87a73919a038e673bfe7758179fca.png] 

In how many years is the profit (Revenue - Expenditure) as a percentage of revenue, more than 28%?
solution:
Calculation: 

In 2014, profit as a percentage of revenue = (120 - 75)/120 × 100% = 37.5%

In 2015, profit as a percentage of revenue = (140 - 100)/140 × 100% ≈ 28.57%

In 2016, profit as a percentage of revenue = (150 - 120)/150 × 100% = 20%

In 2017, profit as a percentage of revenue = (200 - 150)/200 × 100% = 25%

In 2018, profit as a percentage of revenue = (250 - 175)/250 × 100% = 30%

**∴ In 3 years is the profit as a percentage of revenue, more than 28%.**
